entries.title: Philemon 1:1
segments: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy [our] brother, to Philemon the beloved and fellow laborer,

entries.title: Philemon 1:2
segments: and to Apphia the beloved, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house.

entries.title: Philemon 1:3
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:4
segments: I thank my God, making mention of you always in my prayers,

entries.title: Philemon 1:5
segments: hearing of your love and faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all saints,

entries.title: Philemon 1:6
segments: that the fellowship of your faith may operate in a full knowledge of every good thing in you in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philemon 1:7
segments: For we have great joy and consolation over your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed by you, brother.

entries.title: Philemon 1:8
segments: Therefore, having much boldness in Christ to enjoin you to do the fitting thing;

entries.title: Philemon 1:9
segments: rather through love I entreat, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:10
segments: I entreat you for my child Onesimus, whom I have fathered in my bonds,

entries.title: Philemon 1:11
segments: he once worthless to you, but now useful to you and to me; whom I sent back to you.

entries.title: Philemon 1:12
segments: Even receive him, that is, my own heart,

entries.title: Philemon 1:13
segments: whom I resolved to retain with me, so that for you he might have ministered to me in the bonds of the gospel.

entries.title: Philemon 1:14
segments: But without your consent I was willing to do nothing, that your good should not be of necessity, but willingly.

entries.title: Philemon 1:15
segments: For perhaps because of this he was separated from you for an hour, that you should receive him eternally,

entries.title: Philemon 1:16
segments: not now as a slave, but beyond a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

entries.title: Philemon 1:17
segments: If then you have me as a partner, receive him as me.

entries.title: Philemon 1:18
segments: If he has wronged you or owes [you] in anything, put that on my account.

entries.title: Philemon 1:19
segments: I, Paul, wrote it with my own hand; I will repay, that I do not say to you that you owe even yourself to me also.

entries.title: Philemon 1:20
segments: Yes, brother, that I may have your help in the Lord, refresh my heart in the Lord.

entries.title: Philemon 1:21
segments: Trusting to your obedience, I wrote to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

entries.title: Philemon 1:22
segments: But at once prepare lodging for me, for I hope that through your prayers I shall be given to you.

entries.title: Philemon 1:23
segments: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

entries.title: Philemon 1:24
segments: and also Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-laborers.

entries.title: Philemon 1:25
segments: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit.
